payload.focus: Pantry shelf marks: Dario Kent (Pantry Lead) decides every pantry shelf gets a fill line marked at one third so restocking is a visual glance rather than a count. Covers pantry inventory practice, restocking process, shelf labeling, and the Pantry Lead's operational decisions.
payload.rationale: The document sets a one-third fill-line rule for every pantry shelf, which bears directly on the pantry restock threshold position and the November-first pantry restock rule (both expanded with witnesses and children). The 15 October note that oats and rice now restock at half full is a later revision the passes must be able to see, so the shelf-threshold position was expanded in full. The parent narrative Narrative_OperatingRhythmsRunByStatedRules was expanded because it governs how recurring replenishment changes are tied together. I expanded the Thematic door to check for other areas; the only other named area was Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning (product positioning and pricing), which has no overlap with pantry shelf marks, so I deliberately did not expand it. The People door was not expanded separately because Dario Kent's pantry statements are already surfaced under the expanded positions.

positions.name: PantryShelfFillLineMarking
positions.frame: How is the pantry's restock threshold made checkable at the shelf, so that knowing when to restock takes a look rather than a count?
positions.why: Dario's statement carries its own frame. The existing pantry positions ask what fill level triggers a restock, and why the fastest-depleting shelves differ. This one asks how staff tell that a shelf has reached its threshold, answered with a marked fill line and a visual glance in place of counting. It is dated 2026-10-09, before the 2026-10-15 oats-and-rice exception, so a mark 'at a third' on every shelf sits in tension with oats and rice later restocking at half. The tension is left open, since the frame holds both. The statement is a plain assertion of settled practice and bears on the operating-rhythms narrative, which is about recurring operations running by explicit rules.

placements.why: Dario's rule that every shelf carries a fill line at a third is a stated rule for a recurring pantry operation. It sits with the restock-threshold positions already under this narrative, so reuse fits and no new leaf is needed.

weighed.why: Its below-a-third restock rule is the threshold the fill line makes visible, so it supports the operating-rhythms leaf alongside the new position.
Its per-shelf thresholds, including the oats and rice exception, are the rules the shelf marks make checkable. It belongs under the same leaf.

It carries the below-a-third restock rule that opens this practice.
